notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation v1.0.1
notes.content:
1.0.1
- Fixed missing collisions in Chicago
- Fixed Tutorial 2 failing too easily
- Fixed missing twist value in panels for remote boats
- Fixed F50 showing wrong foil type in Setup Screen
- Fixed F50 GBR different font colors on wing
- Fixed F50 FRA font size on wing
- Fixed Bermuda location having 0% salinity
- Water rendering tweaks and performance improvements
- Fixed F50 18m wing not in the water when capsized
- Added full HUD colors customization via config file hud_settings.kl

notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
It is time to test your skills in Hydrofoil Generation, now available in its full version with official SailGP content! 

It’s been a long journey, and we are grateful for all the support we received and the precious feedback gathered while in Early Access. 

Thanks you all, Hydrofoil Generation is the challenge you were waiting for.

[previewyoutube=fFm2E8plwRE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]ABOUT HYDROFOIL GENERATION [/h2]

Hydrofoil Generation puts you in the driving seat of state-of-the-art hydrofoils, including the high-tech, high-speed F50s used in SailGP, modelled with unprecedented accuracy to replicate the exhilarating experience of ‘flying’ over the water at speeds of nearly 100 kmph. Take control of your boat and fine-tune the sailing mechanics of your foils to reduce drag and increase your speed. Customise your craft to overcome the demands of the changing winds, sea conditions and currents as you compete against up to 10 opponents in thrilling multiplayer racers in exciting locations such as Bermuda and Chicago. Thanks to Hydrofoil Generation’s demanding and realistic simulator mechanics, the fine line between speed and capsizing is a continual threat and will not only push your sailing skills but your boat to the very limit. 

[h2]SPECIAL OFFER [/h2]

For a very limited time, Hydrofoil Generation is now available on Steam with a 20% OFF! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1448820/Hydrofoil_Generation/
 
Now let’s raise the sail, the tides are yours to master!

notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation v0.8.1 - OCS hot fix
notes.content:
0.8.1
- Fixed no OCS detection
- Added support for single line comments in Koala
    ex: boat=jx50 // boat to use

notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation v0.8 - Bermuda
notes.content:
0.8.0
- Added Bermuda location
- New timeline crossing system to avoid missing crossings online
    due to unstable connections
- Look left/right on Jx40 uses the corresponding cameras for better visibility
- Fixed viscous drag becoming too big when submerged lengths approach 0
- Fixed and improved Jx40 default skins
- Increased base foil drag on all boats rewarding players flying higher

notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation 0.7.3
notes.content:
0.7.3
- Added Connection Quality indicator in drivable cameras
- Tutorial failure also resets crew position
- Only show "spectate" button if server has spectator slots set
- Fixed Force Feedback pushing when menu screens are visible
- Limited server names to 26 chars
- Better handling of long player names
- Fixed flickering "Hydrofoil Generation" on Den Haag Pier
- Tutorial 5 more lenient on TWA, now allows up to TWA 70°
- Improved Tutorial fail message when failing because of TWA
    shows limits
- HUD color can now be switched with CTRL+H

notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation 0.7.2
notes.content:
0.7.2
- Relaxed tack detection logic making Tutorial 4 & 5 too hard
- Wing camber inversion uses projected TWA only when above 10kn
    avoids wing "flapping" at race start
- Fixed occasional server crash on invalid foil control input
- Fixed "foil speed sensitivity" slider erroneously modified when
    when clicking "edit boat controls"

notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation is out now in Early Access!
notes.content:
It’s time to put your skills and heart to the test!  

We’re happy to announce that [b]Hydrofoil Generation[/b], the most accurate foiling simulation game on the market, [b]is out now on Steam in Early Access[/b]! 

[previewyoutube=H3iH_rEfsAA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]ABOUT HYDROFOIL GENERATION[/h2]

[i]Hydrofoil Generation[/i] puts you at the helm of state-of-the-art sailing craft, modelled with unprecedented accuracy to replicate the exhilarating experience of ‘flying’ over the water at speeds over 50 knots. Take control of your vessel and fine-tune the sailing mechanics of your foils to reduce drag and increase your speed. Customise your craft to overcome the demands of the changing winds, sea conditions and currents as you compete against up to 10 opponents in thrilling multiplayer racers in exciting locations such as Den Haag and Hong Kong.  

[h2]SPECIAL OFFER[/h2]

[i]Hydrofoil Generation[/i] is available now via Steam Early Access for [b]$19.99/€19.99/£17.99[/b] but you can grab it now with a [b]10% OFF as a part of our launch celebration[/b]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1448820/Hydrofoil_Generation/  
[h2]EARLY ACCESS [/h2]

[i]Hydrofoil Generation[/i] is now in Early Access, so this means that the game [b]it's still in active development[/b]. 

[i]Hydrofoil Generation[/i] attempts to recreate a kind of sailing with a simulation depth never attempted before, while we are quite confident when it comes to the physics modeling of the boats things like control systems and game-play elements would greatly be enhanced by early player and [b]community feedback[/b]. 

We will gather feedback from the Steam forum and social media. We will keep an eye on questions and specific suggestions. And, when possible for us, we'll reach out to the sailing community on the sailing competitions forums, sailing social pages, websites or events.

notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation x HOOK
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that [b]Hydrofoil Generation[/b] is coming to [b]PC[/b] via Steam published by [b]HOOK[/b]!

Developed by [b]Jaxx Vane Studio[/b],[i] Hydrofoil Generation[/i] is a passion project from Stefano "kunos" Casillo co-founder of Kunos Simulazioni, the globally acclaimed studio behind the racing simulation masterpiece [i]Assetto Corsa[/i], and is an exciting and accurate first-person simulation of multiplayer "in-shore" regattas. 

[previewyoutube=G9ric5z32T8;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Hydrofoil Generation[/i] puts you at the helm of state-of-the-art sailing craft, modeled with unprecedented accuracy to replicate the exhilarating experience of ‘flying’ over the water at speeds over 50kn. [b]Take control of your vessel[/b] and fine-tune the sailing mechanics of your foils to reduce drag and increase your speed. [b]Customise [/b]your craft to overcome the demands of the changing winds, sea conditions and currents as you [b]compete against up to 10 opponents in thrilling multiplayer racers [/b]in exciting locations such as Den Haag, Hong Kong and Bermuda. 

[b]Features:[/b]
[list][*]Realistic sailing and foiling simulator
[*]Choose from a range of vessels including the 40ft modern foiling monohull Jx40 and the 50ft modern catamaran Jx50
[*]Real regatta fields with coastlines carefully recreated
[*]Vessel customisation system 
[*]Compete against 10 opponents in multiplayer racing sessions[/list]
[b]Hydrofoil Generation[/b] will launch PC via Steam [b]Early Access in early 2023[/b]. Wishlist now and join the discussion on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/jZUUaZkUGP]Discord[/url] channel.
